{{Top|leg}}
The '''Okeefe family''', or '''House Okeefe''', was a noble and prominent [[Brentaalan]] merchant house with a roomily residence on [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Members of this family include the infamous [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]],<ref name="Platt's Smugglers Guide">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref> her aunt [[Sirona Okeefe]], both [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]],<ref name="The Traitor's Gambit">{{DoD|The Traitor's Gambit}}</ref> as well as [[Barthos Okeefe]] who worked as a director at the [[Brentaal HoloNet relay station|HoloNet relay station]] above their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] until the age of sixty. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] a criminal organization named [[Sun Storm]] tried to take over the merchant house.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
